messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

I understand your concern about data safety. The steps we're about to take won't delete any of your photos or data - they're just adjusting your network settings to allow MMS to work properly while traveling abroad.

Based on your network status, I see three key issues we need to address:
1. Your phone is on a 2G network (MMS requires at least 3G)
2. Mobile data is turned off (MMS needs mobile data)
3. Data roaming is off on your device (needed when abroad)

Let's fix these step by step:

**Step 1:** Turn on mobile data on your phone.
Please use: `toggle_data()`

This will enable mobile data. Your phone won't lose any photos or personal data - it just allows internet access over the cellular network.

After you've done this, let me know and we'll proceed to the next step.

I have turned on mobile data on my phone. What should I do next? I'm a bit nervous, but I hope this will help fix the MMS problem.

Please review the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
